title: Make your profile yours, and take control of your camera and mic
summary: Free profile customization for everyone, a camera preview before you go live, and device switching without leaving a call.

new: Profile customization, free for everyone: name colours, gradients, rainbow, neon and shimmer effects
Nameplates behind your name in member lists, friends, direct messages and voice channels
Avatar decorations: neon rings, flames, hearts, stars, snowflakes, holographic frames and more
Profile backgrounds: preset themes, custom gradients or your own image, with position, zoom, opacity, blur and a glass card
Profile effects that play when someone opens your profile, from falling stars to digital rain
Pronouns and up to five links on your profile, plus saved looks you can switch between
A new Profile editor in Settings with a live preview
Camera preview before you turn your camera on or start a video call
Camera and microphone menus on the call bar: switch camera, microphone or speakers without leaving the call
Camera effects processed on your device: brightness, contrast, saturation, colour filters, soft focus and zoom
What's New: release notes in the app and at getemix.com/changelog
improved: Larger, higher-resolution profile banners with adjustable framing
Animated GIF avatars and banners now keep their animation
Microphone level meter in the device menu, so you can check your input before you speak

title: Welcome to Emix
summary: The first Emix release: private messaging, voice and video calls, and screen sharing.

new: The new Emix design, with dark surfaces and pink, purple and blue accents
Video quality settings: 720p to 4K at 30 or 60 fps, with a bitrate choice
The Emix desktop app for Windows, with automatic updates
security: Usage statistics and telemetry are removed: Emix sends no analytics anywhere
